subject: Manager span pilot: proposed pilot, transitions, and HR checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Manager span pilot: proposed pilot, transitions, and HR checklist

Team —

Following last week's leadership sync I pulled together a short pilot plan to experiment with increasing manager spans in two small pods (inference runtime and infra reliability). The goal is to validate whether a slightly larger span improves throughput of cross-functional decisioning and reduces escalation churn without degrading manager bandwidth for 1:1s and career development.

High-level proposal (attached org-chart-span-pilot-v1.pdf):
- Pilot groups: Runtime Surface (8 ICs) and Infra Reliability (7 ICs)
- Manager change: move 1 lead from each pod to report to a neighboring PM/Eng manager to free a manager capacity for a new "cluster" lead to own cross-pod prioritization
- Duration: 12 weeks with defined success metrics (cycle time for ops items, time-to-decision on infra rollouts, manager 1:1 cadence adherence)
- Evaluate: before/after pulse (manager stress, IC clarity), delivery metrics, retention risk flags

Ask: Laura — need HR checklist & communication playbook for a pilot that affects reporting lines for ~4 people (transfers, title hold, comp freeze default). Can you confirm what approvals are required, whether pay changes are necessary for temporary reporting moves, and what documentation we should present to impacted ICs?

Aditya/Marissa — can you review the attached chart and transition-timeline.xlsx and call out any immediate risks (single points of failure, customer-facing responsibilities that cannot shift) by EOD Wednesday? I want to present a 1-pager to Execs next Friday.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org-chart-span-pilot-v1.pdf (diagram), transition-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet), hr-transition-checklist.docx (template)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manager span pilot: proposed pilot, transitions, and HR checklist

Ben —

Quick read-through — this looks sensible as a time-boxed experiment. A couple of immediate items I want to flag:
1) Customer-facing owners: the runtime surface pod carries 2 priority enterprise customers (Acme Analytics and NovaCom). We need a risk mitigation plan for if a manager transition coincides with a high-severity incident window. Suggest adding a 2-week overlap shadowing period where outgoing manager stays on weekly syncs with the new manager for customer escalations.

2) Career development / calibration: if we're moving direct reports across managers, we should capture a "no surprises" calibration doc for each impacted IC so their performance cycle isn't disrupted. HR may need to sign off that the move won't affect performance rating eligibility this cycle.

3) Capacity metrics: recommend instrumenting a lightweight tracker for manager 1:1 duration and frequency (we can prototype in the staff calendar) and a triage-response metric for operational tickets. I can wire a simple template by Thursday.

If HR confirms approval path, I'm fine to pilot both pods simultaneously.

— Aditya
Sr. Engineering Manager

Thanks — a few operational concerns to flag before we present to Execs:

- Compensation/perks: moving reporting lines sometimes triggers comp sequencing rules (promotions vs lateral transfers). Laura — will the transfer count as a role change or simply a reporting change? That drives whether we need People Ops approval this quarter.

- Role clarity for the new cluster lead: the proposal increases cross-pod responsibility for prioritization. We should avoid ambiguous "matrix manager" expectations. Can we draft a short RACI for the cluster lead covering decisions that require escalation vs. those executable without manager sign-off? I can help assemble.

- Communication cadence: frontline engineers are anxious about reorg talk. Recommend an all-hands for each pilot pod the week before transition begins, and 1:1 invites from the new manager to be scheduled in the first week. Let's not surprise anyone.

If Execs are comfortable, I'd ask to pilot only the runtime surface pod first (smaller, clearer customer ownership), then iterate to infra reliability in iteration two. That lowers risk.

— Marissa
VP, Engineering

Ben/Team —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. I've lined up the People Ops checklist and summarized approvals below. Attached I've included a fillable hr-transition-checklist.docx we should use for each impacted IC.

Approvals required (summary):
- Manager and VP approval (documented) — provided by Marissa/Aditya in thread.
- People Ops (me) — confirm no contract or title changes needed for reporting-only moves.
- Compensation Committee (only if pay or title changes) — otherwise not required for temporary reporting shifts.
- Legal sign-off (only if customer-facing NDA/contract exposure changes) — recommend loop-in if responsibilities move across legal boundaries.

Specific notes:
- Reporting-only moves for a 12-week pilot do NOT automatically trigger a comp review. We will flag any exceptions where the role's responsibilities materially change (>20% time on new responsibilities).
- We should document "no impact" statements in the calibration doc before the pilot starts to preserve promotion eligibility. I can template that language.
- Timeline: please complete the hr-transition-checklist.docx for each person by 2026-09-24. People Ops will run a brief compliance review by 2026-09-28.

Communication playbook (short):
1) 1:1 notification with manager present (day 0)
2) pod all-hands with Q&A (day 2)
3) public org update in #eng-ops (day 3)
4) 30/60/90 check-ins scheduled and tracked in the tracker Ben asked for

Next steps: Ben, can you confirm pilot start date (preferred window looks like Oct 5 — gives ad-hoc prep time). Also add the RACI Marissa suggested and send me the list of impacted ICs so I can populate the checklist.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops (interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hr-transition-checklist.docx
